name: Toronto Zoo

research_notes: [2026-08-23] Official-source Wave 3a public list pass (torontozoo.com region inventories). American flamingo maps to the Caribbean card.

do_not_list.name: African elephant
do_not_list.reason: No elephant on official region inventories; African elephant fact sheet 404.

do_not_list.name: Giant panda
do_not_list.reason: Not on official region lists; giant panda fact sheet 404.

do_not_list.name: Sumatran tiger
do_not_list.reason: Official Eurasia Wilds tiger is Amur tiger.

do_not_list.name: Chimpanzee
do_not_list.reason: Not on official region lists; chimpanzee fact sheet 404.

do_not_list.name: Galápagos tortoise
do_not_list.reason: Official tortoise is Aldabra (Rainforest Pavilion), not Galápagos.

do_not_list.name: Asian small-clawed otter
do_not_list.reason: Official otter is North American river otter (Americas).

bonus_hunt.tagline: Toronto bonus · Rainforest Pavilion + Africa Savanna + Americas

challenges.text: Rainforest Pavilion: who looks calmest in the gorilla family?
African penguin: watch one bird enter or leave the water.
American flamingos: more than half on one leg?
River hippo: underwater, mud, or bank?
